web.templatesHint: One click opens the rule already filled in: adjust anything before saving. Nothing is created until you save.

invites.name: Discord invites
invites.hint: Blocks invite links to other servers (discord.gg, discord.com/invite).

links.name: All links
links.hint: Blocks http(s) links. Exempt your sharing channels or trusted roles.

scam.name: Nitro and Steam scams
scam.hint: Fake “free Nitro”, fake Steam gifts and fake Discord domains. Times the author out for 1 hour.

iploggers.name: IP grabbers
iploggers.hint: Blocks link shorteners that log the IP address of whoever clicks (Grabify, IPLogger…).

promo.name: Self-promotion
promo.hint: “Subscribe to my”, “join my server”, “abonne-toi”… in English and French.

swearsFr.name: French swear words
swearsFr.hint: Québec and France swear words. Discord’s built-in lists only cover English.

zalgo.name: Zalgo text
zalgo.hint: Blocks text stacked with marks (z̷̢a̵l̶g̸o̷) that spills over other messages.

insults.name: Insults and sexual content (EN)
insults.hint: Discord’s built-in lists: profanity, sexual content, slurs (English).

spam.name: Spam
spam.hint: Discord’s spam filter: suspicious and repeated messages.

mentions.name: Mass mentions
mentions.hint: Blocks at 5 mentions per message and times the author out for 10 minutes.

names.name: Fake staff names
names.hint: Stops names that imitate the staff or Discord (admin, moderator, support…).

web.rulesHint: Rules are enforced by Discord itself: they work even when Kron is offline. Rules made in Discord show up too.
web.emptyText: Start with a ready-made rule above.

keyword.name: Keywords
keyword.hint: Blocks messages containing these words or matching these regexes.

spam.name: Spam
spam.hint: Discord's spam filter. It has no settings.

mention.name: Mass mentions
mention.hint: Blocks messages with too many mentions (members and roles).

profile.name: Names
profile.hint: Checks member names and profiles when they join and on every change.

web.name: Rule name
web.keywordsHint: * = anything before or after: *cat* catches “concatenate”. Up to 1000 words of 60 characters.
web.regexHint: Rust syntax, up to 10 regexes of 260 characters. Discord rejects invalid ones.
web.allowListHint: These words never trigger the rule.
web.raidProtectionHint: Discord also spots waves of mentions spread over several messages.
web.alertHint: Discord posts an alert with the message in this channel.
web.timeoutHint: Only for keyword and mention rules.
web.profileAction: Discord stops the member from chatting and using the server while their name breaks the rule.

problems.empty: Add at least one word, regex or list.
problems.too_many: 100 exceptions maximum for this rule type.
problems.trigger: Timeouts only work on keyword and mention rules.
problems.no_action: Turn on at least one action.

errors.module_disabled: Turn the AutoMod module on to edit rules.
errors.missing_permissions: Kron needs the “Manage Server” permission to manage AutoMod.
errors.type_limit: Discord limits rules of this type (6 keyword rules, 1 for the others).
errors.invalid_channel: Pick channels and roles from this server.
errors.trigger_changed: A rule's type cannot change: create a new rule.
errors.not_found: This rule no longer exists in Discord.
